raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-17 change notes say amount corrections arrive in the daily delivery as a repeated txn_id with record_version incremented. silver_transactions keeps every POSTED row and never picks the latest version, so each corrected txn_id appears twice and inflates the gold aggregates. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id, before applying the POSTED filter, should remove the duplicates and let a correction that changes status supersede the original.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
